levels.surface: محمد بن عبد الله بن نمير

notes: Two routes split at «ح»; each writes its own names, so neither takes a shared tail
«بنحو حديث الحكم عن ابن أبي ليلى» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route
«علي» in the second route is occurrence 2 (the first is «علي بن أبي طالب» in the first route); the Prophet closes it
«وزاد، في الحديث قال علي» is added wording and «قلت له» in the last remark repeats the second route: both left out
